name: Hooga Retreats
notes: V2 (couples-site-v2) is the current site and is frozen. V3 (couples-site-v3) is the rebuild.
Three retreats near Canterbury: The Showman's Carriage (romance, sleeps 2), The Little Yurt Retreat (enchantment, sleeps 4), The Midnight Express bus (adventure, sleeps 6).

Pete's house rules: sell the dream, get them to book, explain the reality straight after booking, make cancelling easy (no-hassle cancellation within 48 hours of booking). Voice is magic and childlike wonder, not luxury.
Families get an organic route only, with no paid ads.
Reviews in V3 are labelled samples until Pete supplies real ones and video testimonials.
